aberdeen-bazaar.name: Aberdeen Bazaar
aberdeen-bazaar.about:
Aberdeen Bazaar is the shopping centre of Sri Vijaya Puram, the city officially known until 2024 as Port Blair. Aberdeen was one of the stations of the old penal settlement by 1871, and the clock tower in Aberdeen is a long-standing landmark. In 1944 the headquarters of the civil administration was set up near the gurudwara at Aberdeen Bazaar. The district administration lists both Aberdeen and Aberdeen Bazar as revenue villages of the Port Blair tehsil, and the Aberdeen side has government schools, including a Tamil-medium primary school and a CBSE-affiliated senior secondary school.

For tuition, treat this as a market area first: if your home is above a shop or in a lane off the bazaar, give the tutor the lane name and a shop or the clock tower as a reference point. Ask the tutor where they plan to park, and consider a slot before the evening shopping crowd builds, or a weekend morning. Families whose child studies in a Tamil-, Hindi- or Telugu-medium school can ask for a tutor comfortable explaining in that language. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

phoenix-bay.name: Phoenix Bay
phoenix-bay.about:
Phoenix Bay is a bay-side locality of Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair) known to islanders as a departure point for inter-island ships: the weekly ship to Campbell Bay in Great Nicobar leaves from Phoenix Bay. The government building known as Transport Bhawan stands here, and the district administration lists Phoenix Bay as one of the revenue villages of the Port Blair tehsil. Homes here sit alongside government offices and the jetty, so the locality is counted as mixed rather than purely residential.

For a home tutor, the practical point is timing: if you live near the jetty, check ship departure and arrival days and avoid booking a session when passengers and vehicles are gathering there; a fixed weekday evening is easier to keep. Share a clear landmark such as Transport Bhawan and the lane name, because visitors can confuse the jetty side with the residential lanes. Families who move between islands for work, and whose children miss classes, often find a mix of home sessions and online catch-up classes useful. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

haddo.name: Haddo
haddo.about:
Haddo is one of the oldest named parts of Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair): it appears among the stations of the penal settlement by 1871, alongside Aberdeen and South Point. Today the district administration lists Haddo as a revenue village of the Port Blair tehsil. It stands out for schooling in several languages: the Directorate of Education lists English-medium and Telugu-medium primary schools at Haddo, and Hindi-medium and Telugu-medium government senior secondary schools, both on the department's list of CBSE-affiliated schools.

That mix matters when choosing a tutor. A child in a Telugu- or Hindi-medium class may need explanations in that language even though the syllabus and board exams follow CBSE, so mention the medium when you post a requirement. In a government quarters block, give the block and quarter number and the nearest gate; in a family house the tutor can usually come straight to the door. Evenings after school are the usual tuition slot. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

delanipur.name: Delanipur
delanipur.about:
Delanipur is a residential area of Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair), recorded on Wikipedia as an area of the city and on the district school directory as the location of government schools. The Directorate of Education lists a government secondary school at Delanipur among its CBSE-affiliated schools, so many families here follow the CBSE syllabus from the primary classes through Class 10, with senior secondary classes taken at schools elsewhere in the city.

Tell the tutor what kind of home to expect: in a family house the tutor can usually come to the door, while a quarters block or apartment building needs the block and flat number. The step from Class 10 to Class 11 is where families most often look for help, especially in science and mathematics, and an online tutor can cover a specialist subject when no nearby teacher fits the timing. Settle a fixed weekday slot early in the term, before school tests begin. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

junglighat.name: Junglighat
junglighat.about:
Junglighat is a long-established locality of Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair) and one of the 41 revenue villages the district administration lists in the Port Blair tehsil. Property portals list it as a residential locality of the city, and the Directorate of Education lists a government secondary school at Junglighat among its CBSE-affiliated schools, with other government schools in the area on the district directory.

Share the nearest landmark and lane when you book, since house numbers alone can be hard to follow on a first visit; if you live in an apartment building, add the floor and flat number and where a visitor may park. Children in Classes 9 and 10 here usually need support for the CBSE board exams in mathematics and science, and a tutor from a neighbouring locality can often take a regular evening slot. Online classes suit subjects such as accountancy or computer science, where a specialist teacher is harder to find close by. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

school-line.name: School Line
school-line.about:
School Line is a locality of Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair) listed by the district administration as a revenue village of the Port Blair tehsil. It has a government senior secondary school that appears on the Directorate of Education's list of CBSE-affiliated schools, so families here can usually keep a child in one school from the secondary classes up to Class 12. Part of School Line also appears in the census list of villages around the town.

Because senior secondary classes are close by, School Line families often look for tutors in Classes 11 and 12 for physics, chemistry, mathematics, biology and accountancy. Students preparing for entrance exams alongside the board syllabus may combine a home tutor for regular homework with online sessions from a specialist. For a first visit, give the lane and a landmark rather than only a house number, and agree where the tutor should park. Weekday evenings and weekend mornings are the usual tuition times. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

dairy-farm.name: Dairy Farm
dairy-farm.about:
Dairy Farm is a residential locality of Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair), named in the district administration's list of revenue villages of the Port Blair tehsil. The Directorate of Education lists a government secondary school at Dairy Farm among its CBSE-affiliated schools, and the district school directory places a government school here too, so most children in the locality follow CBSE from the early classes.

For tuition, think in terms of the school stage. Primary pupils usually do well with a tutor who can come two or three evenings a week for reading, mathematics and homework, while Class 9 and 10 students need a tutor who knows the CBSE board pattern and sample papers. In a family house the tutor can usually come to the door; give a clear landmark for the first visit. If the right subject teacher lives on the far side of the city, home visits at weekends and online classes on weekdays keep the routine steady. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bathubasti.name: Bathubasti (Bathu Basti)
bathubasti.about:
Bathubasti, also written Bathu Basti or Bathu Basthi, is a locality of Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair) with a local bazaar. The district school directory lists a government school at Bathu Basthi, and property portals list rental homes here in multi-storey apartment buildings as well as houses, which gives it a busier, mixed feel than the quieter lanes elsewhere.

The housing mix decides how a tutor visit works. In an apartment building, give the floor and flat number and tell the tutor where visitors may park; in a house, the tutor can usually come to the door. The bazaar is busiest in the evening, so a session that starts before the market rush avoids delays. Most children here study the CBSE syllabus, which government secondary and senior secondary schools across the islands follow, so a tutor familiar with CBSE textbooks and sample papers is the usual fit for Classes 6 to 10. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

dollygunj.name: Dollygunj
dollygunj.about:
Dollygunj is one of the villages the Andaman and Nicobar administration planned in 2011 to bring into the Port Blair municipal limits, citing a substantial rise in commercial and housing activity in villages next to the town; the city limits were expanded in 2015. The district administration lists Dollygunj as a revenue village of the Port Blair tehsil, property portals list residential plots and houses here, and the district school directory places a government school in the locality.

Where a family lives in a house on its own plot, a tutor can usually come straight to the door, but addresses in the newer lanes can be hard to find, so share a landmark or a map pin before the first class. Families on the edge of the city sometimes find fewer tutors nearby for senior classes; in that case a home tutor for the core subject and online classes for a second subject work well together. Fix the slot around school bus and work timings to keep the routine regular. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

garacharma.name: Garacharma
garacharma.about:
Garacharma is a census town in South Andaman district just outside Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair), according to Wikipedia, and one of the villages the administration planned in 2011 to bring into the municipal limits because of growing housing and commercial activity. The district administration lists Garacharma as a revenue village of the Port Blair tehsil, and the district school directory places a government school here. Property portals list residential plots for sale.

For a first visit, share a map pin and a nearby landmark, because newer homes on plotted land are not always easy to find by house number. Tutors living in the central localities may travel out only on certain days, so families here often book two fixed weekday slots, or combine a weekend home class with online sessions on weekdays, especially for Classes 11 and 12. If you live in a house, the tutor can usually come straight to the door. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

prothrapur.name: Prothrapur
prothrapur.about:
Prothrapur is one of the larger settlements of South Andaman Island and one of the villages the administration planned in 2011 to add to the Port Blair municipal limits. The district administration lists it as a revenue village of the Port Blair tehsil, and it has a government senior secondary school on the Directorate of Education's list of CBSE-affiliated schools, so children here can study through to Class 12 without moving to a school in the centre of the city.

With senior secondary classes on hand, the most common tuition need in Prothrapur is Class 11 and 12 science, commerce and mathematics. A first-time visitor should get a landmark and a map pin, and in a house the tutor can usually come to the door. Where a specialist teacher for physics, chemistry or accountancy lives across the city, an online tutor for that subject alongside a home tutor for regular homework keeps the timetable manageable. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

brookshabad.name: Brookshabad
brookshabad.about:
Brookshabad (also spelt Brooksabad) is a revenue village of the Port Blair tehsil in the district administration's list. In 2011 the administration proposed bringing part of Brookshabad into the Port Blair municipal limits, along with nine other villages next to the town, because of the growth of housing and commercial activity there. Census lists also show part of Brookshabad among the villages around the town, so some homes fall within the city and some just outside.

For a tutor visit, the address detail matters more than the boundary. Share the lane, a landmark and a map pin, because newer homes on the edge of the city are often not easy to find from a house number. Children from Brookshabad usually attend CBSE-affiliated schools, since government secondary and senior secondary schools in the islands follow CBSE, so a tutor familiar with CBSE textbooks is the usual match, and online classes can fill gaps for subjects with fewer local teachers. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

austinabad.name: Austinabad
austinabad.about:
Austinabad is listed by the district administration as a revenue village of the Port Blair tehsil. In 2011 the administration planned to bring part of Austinabad into the Port Blair municipal limits, together with villages such as Garacharma, Dollygunj, Prothrapur and Brookshabad, because housing and commercial activity next to the town had grown substantially. The city limits were expanded in 2015.

For families in Austinabad, a map pin and a landmark help the tutor on the first visit, and in a house the tutor can usually come straight to the door. Tutors who live in the central localities may be able to come only on fixed days, so agree the weekly pattern before the demo class. For senior classes, a home tutor for the main subject plus online classes for a second subject is a common arrangement, and it avoids long evening journeys during the monsoon months. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

Aberdeen & Old Town.fact: Aberdeen Bazaar is a shopping centre in Port Blair (Sri Vijaya Puram), South Andaman Island.
On 21 March 1944 the headquarters of the civil administration was established near the gurudwara at Aberdeen Bazaar.
By 1871 the penal settlement included stations such as Aberdeen, Haddo, South Point and Navy Bay; the clock tower in Aberdeen is a historic landmark.
The ship MV Campbell Bay operates once a week from Port Blair (Phoenix Bay) to Campbell Bay.
Transport Bhawan is located at Phoenix Bay.
Haddo, Aberdeen, Aberdeen Bazar and Phoenix Bay are among the 41 revenue villages of Port Blair tehsil.
Haddo has Hindi-medium and Telugu-medium government senior secondary schools, and Aberdeen has a Tamil-medium government primary school.

Junglighat & Central Localities.fact: Government secondary schools at Junglighat, Dairy Farm and Delanipur and a government senior secondary school at School Line are on the Directorate of Education's list of CBSE-affiliated schools.
Junglighat, Dairy Farm and School Line are revenue villages of Port Blair tehsil.
Delanipur is an area of Port Blair.
The district school directory lists government schools at Bathu Basthi, Junglighat, Delanipur, Dairy Farm and School Line.
The civic body, Port Blair Municipal Council, now styles itself Sri Vijaya Puram Municipal Council and came into existence on 2 October 1957.
The municipal council has 24 wards after the expansion of municipal limits in 2015.

Expansion Villages.fact: In 2011 the Andaman and Nicobar administration planned to extend Port Blair's municipal limits by adding ten villages: Garacharma, Brichgunj, Dollygunj, Brookshabad (part), Prothrapur, Austinabad (part), Calicut, Bimblitan, Sippighat and Teylerabad.
The reason given was a substantial rise in commercial and housing activity in these villages adjoining the municipal area.
Port Blair's city limits were expanded in 2015.
Garacharma is a census town in South Andaman district just outside Sri Vijaya Puram.
Bambooflat, Prothrapur and Garacharma are among the other large settlements of South Andaman Island.
Prothrapur has a government senior secondary school on the list of CBSE-affiliated schools.
National Highway 4 connects Port Blair with Diglipur in North Andaman.

board_facts.fact: The South Andaman district administration states: 'All the Sr. Secondary and Secondary schools are affiliated to CBSE.'
The same page says education in the islands is provided in five mediums: English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and Bengali (the page's figures are dated September 2008).

The Directorate of Education runs CASIAN, a common web portal for CBSE-affiliated government schools under the Directorate of Education, Andaman and Nicobar Islands; it lists its government schools (archived June 2025; the live site did not resolve on 3 Oct 2026).

In and around Sri Vijaya Puram the CASIAN list includes government secondary or senior secondary schools at Aberdeen, Haddo (including a Telugu-medium school), School Line, Junglighat, Delanipur, Dairy Farm, South Point and Prothrapur.
No separate Andaman and Nicobar school board is named on these official pages; secondary and senior secondary schools are described as CBSE-affiliated.
Renaming: on 13 September 2024 the Government of India decided to rename Port Blair, the capital of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, as Sri Vijaya Puram.
